      - generic: "In the September 2026 ISC2 CC outline, Domain 2 shifts from legacy BC/DR/IR to Security Governance (17.3% exam weight), opening with Objective 2.1: Plan Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC). Course slides S01 and S02 define GRC as a structured, integrated, and coordinated approach organizations use to manage cybersecurity alongside business requirements. Deploying technical controls such as firewalls, EDR, or MFA without GRC leaves fundamental questions unanswered: Which business services matter most? Who has authority to accept or mitigate risk?
